pages.caption: A Son Who Spent Everything, a Speech He Never Finished, and a Brother Who Stayed Outside.
The Son Demands His Inheritance, the Father Runs to Meet Him, and the Brother Stays Outside.
The Father Throws a Feast, the Son Repents, and the Brother Refuses to Join.
The Father Embraces the Son, the Feast Begins, and the Brother Watches from Afar.
The Celebration Continues, the Son is Restored, and the Brother Remains Outside.
The Father Forgives, the Son Rejoices, and the Brother Wrestles with Jealousy.
The Family is Reunited, the Feast is in Full Swing, and the Brother Begins to Understand.
The Father Continues to Show Grace, the Son Learns Humility, and the Brother Slowly Accepts.
The Story of Redemption Unfolds, the Family is Healed, and the Brother Finally Joins the Celebration.
